name: n5-monthly-revenue-pack-environment
description: Runtime for refreshing a semantic model, rendering a report, and distributing a revenue pack.

tools.refresh_semantic_model: Refreshes the semantic model and records model_refreshed.
tools.render_revenue_report: Renders the revenue report after refresh and records report_rendered.
tools.distribute_revenue_pack: Distributes the revenue pack after rendering and records pack_distributed.
